test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct idiom to substitute the underlined word segment in the following sentence.

When the teacher asked him about the homework, he started __speaking vaguely to avoid talking about it .__

options.text: searching the bird in the bush

solution:
The correct answer is "**beating around the bush"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The idiom '**beating around the bush**' has the same meaning, referring to avoiding the issue or circumventing the main point. (घुमा-फिराकर बात करना)

 
 
• **Example**- The suspect kept speaking vaguely to avoid talking about his whereabouts during the crime.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given phrase is 'beating around the bush'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the remaining options' meanings:
 
• '**Searching around the room' **refers to the act of looking thoroughly in a room. (कमरे के चारों ओर खोजन)
 
• **'Searching the bird in the bush**' means looking for a bird in a bush. (झाड़ी में पक्षी की खोज करना)
